name: CancelOrder
description: Cancel (soft-delete) a sales order in SAP. Use when the user asks to cancel or hủy an order. Employee may cancel their own order; Manager/Admin may cancel others. Prefer this over RejectOrder when the user says cancel/hủy without a rejection reason code. Do not use for reject approval (deny release request) or Admin force cancel.

reason.description: Optional free-text cancel reason. Use null if not provided.
